title: Skysquare is context as a service - Travis Simpson - @skysquare.app
creator: did:plc:7tattzlorncahxgtdiuci7x7

transcription.text: Before I start, I want to thank the @Science team for the invitation, and especially a special thank you out to Matthew and Ronan for helping me get this presentation sorted. And of course, thank you to the Blue Sky and @proto teams for making this kind of work possible to begin with. SkySquare is a Chrome and Brave extension built on @proto. Yeah, we can also just send it out, I guess, if nothing else works. The conversation about external sources on the web, SkySquare aggregates and presents that commentary directly on the page inside a sidebar on the browser, so you can see the commentary in context while you read. To demonstrate how the application works, we've imagined a fictional research setting, Research One University, and its animal cognition lab. You'll be hearing from Claire Lynn— I am a PI at Research One University's Animal Cognition Lab. I use SkySquare to see how people are interpreting people and ideas. Or if we figure it out later, we can always try to come back to it. Okay, so yeah, thank you. This is the first half of the day. We have unconference boards in the back. So if you had questions or things you want to make sure you're remembering, we're encouraging you to add a Post-it note on the unconference board. And other than that, yeah, we'll just be back here at 1:30. Thanks everyone so far. It's been awesome. See you soon.
